verdict.rationale: Devin has a documented API (devin-docs-7) intended for programmatic integration, implying API key auth as an alternative to account login, and even supports creating sessions on behalf of other users (devin-docs-8), suggesting a service-level credential model. However, no explicit documentation of API key generation/management or authentication mechanics is present in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit API key creation/management docs, confirmation that API key auth fully replaces login flows, and independent/community verification of this workflow.
